scientific_integrity: The proof is a four-state graph reduction and exact finite Boolean relation-monoid closure, supported by standalone integer-only executable certificate. Exhaustive finite closure is used to establish all word lengths; small-ring tests are separate corroboration.
scientific_limitations: One time step of the classical binary Rule 54 on the bilateral full shift only; no classification of all preimage periods or multiplicities, temporal attractors, or iterated dynamics. Historical priority remains uncertain without independent examination of all early catalogues.
title: An exceptional fixed point in the periodic-point lifting of Rule 54
